items.title: 產業表態挺撥補台電中油 基本薪資連11漲？龔明鑫：提供受調薪衝擊企業「配套」
items.title_en: Industry Voices Support Funding for Taipower and CPC, Basic Wage May Rise for 11 Consecutive Years? Minister Gong Ming‑xin: Provide Packages for Companies Hit by Wage Increases
paras: 經濟部今（15) 日舉行第4場產業公協會交流會議，經濟部長龔明鑫會後表示，當前國內經濟成長亮眼，企業適度調高基層勞工薪資方向正確，產業界普遍認同調升大方向，但調幅需審慎考量。龔明鑫指出，產業界亦全力支持政府合理撥補台電與中油以穩定物價，經濟部更規劃未來8年投入1000億元加碼支持中小微企業轉型發展，若工資調高衝擊弱勢企業，政府責無旁貸將提供必要協助。
針對即將於24日登場的最低工資審議會，龔明鑫受訪時指出，隨著現行月薪29500元、時薪196元劃下句點，若迎來連續11年調漲，外界預期月薪極可能首度挑戰3萬元大關。他表示，今日與會的公協會代表普遍認同最低工資調升的大方向，但科技業以外的中小企業與傳統產業並未完全享受經濟成長紅利，仍面臨獲利有限壓力。
龔明鑫進一步說明，最低工資調高後，勞工退休金提撥、勞保及健保費用均會連動調整，對雇主而言，實際增加的不僅是基本薪資本身，隨之墊高的法定成本負擔同樣沉重。經濟部會在審議會召開時，如實反映產業界對承擔上限的擔憂。至於若中小微企業或傳統產業營運受衝擊，龔明鑫強調，不論最終審定調幅為何，若有弱勢企業面臨困難，政府責無旁貸會予以協助。
此外，在穩定物價與產業支持方面，產業界在會中表達支持政府合理撥補台電、中油，讓兩家國營事業穩健經營，繼續發揮平穩物價、照顧民生的功能。龔明鑫強調，公協會是政府與企業重要的橋樑，經濟部會持續把第一線需求帶進政策。
同時，經濟部持續加大對中小微企業的支持力道，將從每年超過100億元的計畫升級，推動修訂中小微企業轉型升級發展條例，預計未來8年加碼投入1000億元預算。透過數位轉型、淨零轉型、通路發展、群聚共榮、新創拔尖等5大策略，搭配優惠貸款、租稅優惠與信保加碼3大配套，全力協助全台171萬家中小微企業提升國際競爭力。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held its fourth industry‑association dialogue today (the 15th). After the meeting, Minister Gong Ming‑xin said that the domestic economy is performing well and that it is correct for companies to modestly raise base‑level workers’ wages. The industry broadly agrees with the overall direction of a wage increase, but the magnitude must be considered carefully. Gong noted that the industry fully backs the government’s reasonable subsidies to Taipower and CPC to stabilise prices, and the ministry plans to invest NT$100 billion over the next eight years to further support the transformation of small and micro enterprises. If higher wages hurt vulnerable firms, the government has an undeniable responsibility to provide necessary assistance.

Regarding the minimum‑wage review meeting scheduled for the 24th, Gong said that with the current monthly minimum of NT$29,500 and hourly minimum of NT$196 set to end, a possible 11‑year streak of raises could push the monthly floor to the NT$30,000 mark for the first time. He said that today’s association representatives generally support the overall direction of a higher minimum wage, but small‑ and medium‑sized firms outside the tech sector and traditional industries have not fully enjoyed the benefits of economic growth and still face limited profit pressure.

Gong further explained that once the minimum wage is raised, contributions to workers’ retirement funds, labor insurance and health insurance will also increase, meaning employers will face higher statutory cost burdens in addition to the higher base pay. The ministry will faithfully convey industry concerns about the ceiling of these obligations at the review meeting. Should small‑ and micro‑enterprises or traditional sectors be adversely affected, Gong stressed that regardless of the final adjustment size, the government will step in to help any vulnerable companies that encounter difficulties.

In addition, on price stability and industry support, the business side expressed backing for the government’s reasonable subsidies to Taipower and CPC, enabling the two state‑owned utilities to operate soundly and continue to help keep prices stable and protect livelihoods. Gong emphasized that industry associations serve as an important bridge between the government and businesses, and the ministry will keep bringing frontline needs into policy making.

The ministry also continues to ramp up support for small and micro enterprises, upgrading a program that already exceeds NT$10 billion annually. It will revise the Small and Micro Enterprise Transformation and Upgrading Development Act and plans to inject an additional NT$100 billion over the next eight years. Through five major strategies—digital transformation, net‑zero transition, channel development, cluster prosperity, and nurturing top‑tier startups—combined with three supporting measures—preferential loans, tax incentives and enhanced credit guarantees—the government aims to help Taiwan’s 1.71 million small and micro firms boost their international competitiveness.

items.title: 創博會9/17世貿登場 科技館展技術涵蓋AI應用從晶片散熱到癌症早篩偵測
items.title_en: Taiwan Innovation Expo Opens Sept 17 at Taipei World Trade Center, Showcasing AI from Chip Cooling to Early Cancer Screening
paras: 「2026台灣創新技術博覽會-未來科技館(FUTEX)」將於本周9月17日-19日在台北世貿一館登場，由國科會攜手中研院、教育部、衛福部及運動部主辦。國科會表示，今年未來科技館聚焦AI生活應用、產業關鍵技術及國家科研三大面向，展出從智慧健康、運動賽事與虛擬試衣，到AI晶片散熱、癌症早篩、自主衛星及智慧防災等成果，也完整展現最具體驗性、產業潛力及社會價值的AI科技亮點。
國科會表示，今年未來科技館聚焦三大面向，展出從智慧健康、運動賽事與虛擬試衣，到AI晶片散熱、癌症早篩、自主衛星及智慧防災等成果，完整呈現最具體驗性、產業潛力及社會價值的科技亮點。
國科會指出，AI不再只是研究室裡的模型與數據，而是走入人們的健康、娛樂、消費與飲食生活，今年展場規劃多項互動體驗，讓民眾直接感受AI如何回應生活中的真實需求。
其中包括高雄科大研發的「iMirror人工智慧健康促進暨賦能互動式魔鏡」，透過單一鏡頭與AI邊緣運算，就能分析步態穩定度、體適能及跌倒風險，參觀者只要站在鏡子前走動或伸展，便能看到即時分析結果，未來可應用於醫院復健追蹤及居家照護。
棒球迷則可關注「聽懂球員綽號」的AI賽事系統，由台科大團隊結合語音辨識與多模態AI，自動標記全壘打、三振等事件，民眾只要說出球員名稱或綽號，系統便能快速搜尋並播放相關片段，展現AI應用於賽事轉播、影音內容管理與運動娛樂的新可能。
此外，「生成式AI虛擬試衣系統」讓參觀者站在螢幕前即可體驗AI從服裝設計、樣品製作到智慧零售的應用；「AI豬隻瘦肉量自動化檢測系統」則透過影像辨識，串聯飼養、肉質分級與零售端數據，讓科技深入傳統農畜養殖產業，協助提升生產效率與品質管理。
對企業而言，今年未來科技館遴選出84件獲獎技術，橫跨AI、半導體與光電通訊、生技新藥與醫材、先進材料與化工、綠能環保、淨零及人文科技等領域，其中多項成果已完成初步驗證，或正與產業展開合作。
面對AI高效能運算帶來的散熱與能耗挑戰，「跨重力場被動式螺旋結構液氣分流散熱技術」運用獨創氣泡脫離機制，可整合於高功率AI晶片及資料中心兩相浸沒式冷卻系統；國研院展出的「晶片級先進封裝異質整合平台」，則提供先進製程級別的封裝技術，並獨創去除封裝基板的「CoCoB 」架構，滿足現代資料中心龐大的算力需求。

AI醫療部分，展出診斷平台鎖定早期不易發現的胰臟癌，並已完成跨國臨床盲測驗證；「DeepBT A+腦瘤MRI智慧輔助判讀系統」累積逾2,500例臨床案例，可協助醫療人員進行多任務病灶分析與報告生成，縮短報告周轉時間58%。「PanMETAI—1H NMR代謝體與AI聯合診斷平台」鎖定早期不易發現的胰臟癌，並已完成跨國臨床盲測驗證；「DeepBT A+腦瘤MRI智慧輔助判讀系統」累積逾2,500例臨床案例，可協助醫療人員進行多任務病灶分析與報告生成，縮短報告周轉時間58%。這些成果顯示，AI不只追求模型效能，更能進一步回應臨床流程、產業導入及實際應用需求。
除了產業應用，未來科技館也呈現國家級科研設施與學研團隊如何支援關鍵科技發展，回應環境監測、防災應變、公共安全與國家韌性等需求；國家太空中心以福爾摩沙衛星八號為展出主軸，展示衛星模型、推進次系統、光學遙測酬載及次米級影像應用平臺等成果，讓民眾與產業界了解台灣衛星自主研發的最新進展及太空科技在環境監測、農業、交通與國土管理等領域的應用潛力。
paras_en: The 2026 Taiwan Innovation Technology Expo – Future Technology Hall (FUTEX) will be held from September 17‑19 this week at Hall 1 of the Taipei World Trade Center, organized by the National Science and Technology Council together with Academia Sinica, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the Ministry of Sports. The council says this year’s Future Technology Hall focuses on three pillars – AI life applications, key industrial technologies, and national research – and will exhibit achievements ranging from smart health, sports events and virtual fitting rooms to AI chip cooling, early‑cancer screening, autonomous satellites and intelligent disaster prevention, fully demonstrating AI highlights with the most experiential, industrial potential and social value.

The council states that this year’s Future Technology Hall concentrates on three major aspects, showcasing results from smart health, sports events and virtual fitting rooms to AI chip cooling, early‑cancer screening, autonomous satellites and intelligent disaster prevention, presenting technology highlights that are highly experiential, industrially promising, and socially valuable.

The council points out that AI is no longer confined to models and data in research labs; it has entered people’s health, entertainment, consumption and dietary lives. This year’s exhibition plans multiple interactive experiences so the public can directly feel how AI responds to real‑world needs.

One exhibit is the “iMirror AI Health Promotion and Empowerment Interactive Mirror” developed by Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology. Using a single camera and edge AI computing, it can analyze gait stability, fitness level and fall risk. Visitors who stand, walk or stretch in front of the mirror see real‑time analysis results, a technology that could later be applied to hospital rehabilitation tracking and home care.

Baseball fans can check out an AI sports‑broadcast system that “understands players’ nicknames.” Developed by a team from National Taiwan University of Science and Technology, it combines speech recognition and multimodal AI to automatically tag home runs, strike‑outs and other events. Users simply say a player’s name or nickname, and the system quickly retrieves and plays the relevant clip, showcasing new possibilities for AI in sports broadcasting, video‑content management and entertainment.

A “generative‑AI virtual fitting system” lets visitors stand before a screen and experience AI‑driven applications from garment design and sample production to smart retail. An “AI automated pork leanness detection system” uses image recognition to link breeding, meat‑grade classification and retail data, bringing technology deep into traditional livestock farming to help improve production efficiency and quality control.

For businesses, this year’s Future Technology Hall selected 84 award‑winning technologies spanning AI, semiconductors and optoelectronic communications, biotech drugs and medical devices, advanced materials and chemicals, green energy, net‑zero initiatives, and humanities‑tech. Many of these results have completed preliminary validation or are already collaborating with industry.

Facing the heat‑dissipation and power‑consumption challenges of high‑performance AI computing, a “cross‑gravity‑field passive spiral‑structure liquid‑gas split cooling technology” uses a novel bubble‑release mechanism and can be integrated into high‑power AI chips and two‑phase immersion cooling systems for data centers; Academia Sinica’s “chip‑level advanced packaging heterogeneous integration platform” offers advanced‑process‑level packaging and a unique “CoCoB” architecture that removes the substrate, meeting the massive compute demand of modern data centers.

In AI medical applications, a diagnostic platform targeting early‑stage pancreatic cancer has completed multinational blind clinical trials; the “DeepBT A+ brain‑tumor MRI intelligent assistance system” has accumulated over 2,500 clinical cases, helping clinicians perform multi‑task lesion analysis and report generation, cutting report turnaround time by 58%; the “PanMETAI – 1H NMR metabolomics and AI joint diagnostic platform” also focuses on early pancreatic cancer and has finished cross‑border blind trials. These achievements show that AI not only pursues model performance but also addresses clinical workflow, industry adoption, and real‑world needs.

Beyond industry uses, the Future Technology Hall also showcases national research facilities and academic teams supporting key technology development, responding to environmental monitoring, disaster response, public safety and national resilience needs. The National Space Organization highlights the Formosa Satellite‑8, displaying satellite models, propulsion subsystems, optical remote‑sensing payloads and sub‑meter imaging platforms, helping the public and industry understand Taiwan’s latest autonomous satellite progress and the potential of space technology for environmental monitoring, agriculture, transportation and land‑management.

items.title: 財部拍板中韓電磁鋼品傾銷 追繳反傾銷稅最高達59%
items.title_en: Ministry of Finance Approves Anti-Dumping Duties on Korean and Chinese Electromagnetic Steel, Up to 59%
paras: 財政部今（15）日公告針對自韓國及中國大陸進口「冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品」反傾銷調查最終認定，確認兩地涉案廠商均存在傾銷事實。其中韓國廠商傾銷差率最高達59.35%，中國廠商則為26.44%。關務署已通知各海關自即日起改依最後認定傾銷差率臨時課徵反傾銷稅，並已移送經濟部進行國家經濟利益與產業損害之最後認定，最快於50天內提報關稅稅率審議小組決定是否正式開徵。
本次反傾銷調查案係由國內鋼鐵龍頭中鋼 (2002-TW) 提出申請。關務署表示，財政部於115年9月15日正式公告調查結果，證實自韓國及中國進口之冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品確實對國內產業造成不公競爭。
根據財政部最後認定之傾銷差率如下：
關務署說明，財政部先前於115年6月2日公告初步認定結果，並自6月8日起實施臨時課徵反傾銷稅。由於本次最後認定之傾銷差率有所調整，關務署已同步通知各進口地海關，自9月15日起改依最後認定之最新傾銷差率進行臨時課徵。若最終審議核定無須課徵反傾銷稅，先前臨時課徵之款項將依法辦理退還。
針對後續調查流程，關務署進一步指出，財政部已依據「平衡稅及反傾銷稅課徵實施辦法」規定，通知經濟部繼續完成傾銷是否對台灣產業造成損害之最後調查認定，並評估課稅對國家整體經濟利益之影響。經濟部將於接獲通知翌日起40日內完成調查認定；財政部則會在收到經濟部通知後10日內，提交關稅稅率審議小組審議，以做出最終是否正式課徵反傾銷稅之決議。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance announced today (the 15th) the final anti‑dumping investigation results for imports of "cold‑rolled flat‑rolled non‑grain-oriented electromagnetic steel" from South Korea and mainland China, confirming that manufacturers in both regions have engaged in dumping. The Korean firms’ dumping margin tops out at 59.35%, while the Chinese firms’ margin is 26.44%. The Customs Administration has instructed all customs offices to start levying provisional anti‑dumping duties based on the final margin rates from today, and the case has been forwarded to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for a final determination of national economic interest and industry damage, with a proposal to the Tariff Rate Review Committee expected within 50 days.

The anti‑dumping case was initiated by domestic steel leader China Steel (2002‑TW). The Customs Administration said the Ministry of Finance formally announced the investigation results on September 15, 2026, confirming that imports of cold‑rolled flat‑rolled non‑grain‑oriented electromagnetic steel from Korea and China create unfair competition for the local industry.
The Ministry of Finance’s final determined dumping margins are as follows:

The Customs Administration explained that the Ministry of Finance previously announced a preliminary determination on June 2, 2026, and began provisional anti‑dumping duties on June 8. Because the final dumping margins have been adjusted, customs offices have been notified to apply the updated provisional duties starting September 15. If the final review decides no duties are required, the previously collected provisional duties will be refunded according to law.

Regarding the next steps, the Customs Administration said the Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the "Implementation Measures for Balanced Tax and Anti‑Dumping Tax," has instructed the Ministry of Economic Affairs to complete the final assessment of whether dumping harms Taiwan’s industry and to evaluate the impact of the duties on overall national economic interests. The Ministry of Economic Affairs will finish its investigation within 40 days of receiving the notice, and the Ministry of Finance will submit the findings to the Tariff Rate Review Committee within 10 days thereafter to decide whether to impose formal anti‑dumping duties.

items.title: 能率亞洲現增案完成募集4.61億元 現增股9/18上櫃買賣
items.title_en: Nengli Asia Completes Capital Raise of NT$461 million; New Shares to Trade on OTC on Sep 18
paras: 創投業指標股能率亞洲 (7777-TW)執行上櫃以來首度的市場籌資案，能率亞洲發行1.6萬張現增股，以每股28.8元發行，今(15)日宣布完成募 籌資約4.61億元，現增股9月18日上櫃交易。
能率亞洲的此一發行1.6萬張現增股的市場籌資案，由第一金證券主辦，由全體股東依持股比例認購。募集資金用途將爲充實營運資金。
能率亞洲今天股價收在35.35元，相較於現增價有仍有22.74%的價差空間，且能率亞洲並已取得 OTC 的融資、融券交易資格。
目前能率亞洲著眼投資四大領域，包含 AI 供應鏈、機器人、半導體、軍工，著眼在產業發展趨勢。同時亦布局高殖利率股，兼顧獲利穩定。
同時，全球首家成功商業化機器人廠商 Agility，是能率亞洲在機器人概念的重點持股。能率亞洲及能率集團相關資金合計投資約 1000 萬美元，Agility Robotics 已與主要客戶完成完整測試，結果符合預期，並與豐田汽車就加拿大工廠物流自動化啟動概念驗證。
能率亞洲2026年上半年財報稅後純益1.51億元，每股純益0.81元。
paras_en: Venture-capital benchmark stock Nengli Asia (7777‑TW) executed its first market capital‑raising since listing on the OTC, issuing 16,000 new shares at NT$28.8 each. The company announced today (the 15th) that it has completed fundraising of about NT$461 million, and the new shares will begin OTC trading on September 18.
The 16,000‑share issuance was organized by First Financial Securities, with all shareholders subscribing in proportion to their holdings. The proceeds will be used to strengthen working capital.
Nengli Asia’s stock closed today at NT$35.35, leaving a 22.74% price gap above the issuance price, and the company has already obtained OTC financing and margin‑trading qualifications.

The company is focusing its investments on four major areas—AI supply chain, robotics, semiconductors and defense industry—aligned with industry trends, while also allocating to high‑yield stocks for stable earnings.

Agility Robotics, the world’s first company to successfully commercialize robots, is a key robotics‑concept holding for Nengli Asia. Together with the Nengli Group, they have invested roughly US$10 million; Agility Robotics has completed full testing with major customers, meeting expectations, and has launched a proof‑of‑concept with Toyota for logistics automation at a Canadian plant.
Nengli Asia reported a post‑tax net profit of NT$151 million for the first half of 2026, equating to earnings of NT$0.81 per share.

items.title: 建構全台環島車充電路網 交通部：截至目前公共充電樁已逾1.6萬槍
items.title_en: Building a Nationwide Island‑wide EV Charging Network: MOEA Reports Over 16,000 Public Chargers
paras: 為建構電動車友善使用環境，滿足日益成長的電動車充電需求，交通部推動公共充電樁建置，截至今(2026)年7月底，全國公共充電樁總數已達16,280槍，對應同期電動小客車登記數共149,322輛，車樁比為9.2:1，優於歐盟建議之10:1，其中快充的車樁比為35.7:1，也優於歐盟建議之80:1。
交通部路政司指出，為布局環臺充電路網，解決電動車駕駛在公路沿線上之長途里程焦慮，相關部屬機關已於各所屬轄管場域設有充電站點，提供民眾中繼補電之服務。
交通部舉例，在國道上，高公局已於2024年8月完成「國道服務區充電路網全面上線」，且全數為200kW以上快充樁，七成為350、360kW，配合電動車數量成長，高公路在今年度更針對清水服務區及湖口服務區(南北站)，已啟動優先擴充充電車位作業，三站各增設4格，共計擴充12格，持續提升電動車充電服務；清水服務區已於今年2月擴充完成並開始營運，目前國道快充站共計設有154格充電車位。
另外，在西部主要幹線台61線西濱快速公路沿線，公路局已分別於新豐休息站、大安休息站及口湖休息站共計設有13槍快充樁；東部地區則有台鐵公司亦於去(2025)年7月完成啟用「宜花東充電站網絡」，沿著台9線公路及緊臨台鐵車站， 於宜蘭縣、花蓮縣及臺東縣9個站點，共計設置20槍公共充電樁，緩解民眾在東部駕駛電動車之里程焦慮。
路政司官員表示，隨著公部門帶頭布建，國內的電動車充電環境已逐步完善，並帶動民間充電樁市場發展日趨蓬勃，據資料蒐集顯示，目前已有54家充電營運商投入充電服務，相較2023年第3季總家數成長更達一倍以上。
未來交通部除持續攜手相關部會與地方政府推動增設公共充電樁外，政策推動亦將由初期「積極擴增數量」階段，深化至「提升營運服務品質」階段，如確保充電設施可用性、也督促業者落實營運管理等，藉此打造更便捷、可靠且友善的公共充電服務網絡。
paras_en: To create an EV‑friendly environment and meet the growing demand for electric‑vehicle charging, the Ministry of Transportation and Communications (MOTC) has been promoting the installation of public charging stations. As of the end of July 2026, the total number of public chargers nationwide reached 16,280 units, corresponding to 149,322 registered electric passenger cars, yielding a vehicle‑to‑charger ratio of 9.2:1—better than the EU’s recommended 10:1. For fast chargers, the ratio is 35.7:1, also surpassing the EU’s 80:1 guideline.

The MOTC’s Road Administration Department noted that, to establish an island‑wide charging network and alleviate long‑distance range anxiety for EV drivers on highways, relevant agencies have set up charging stations within their respective jurisdictions to provide intermediate recharging services for the public.

The ministry cited that on national highways, the Highways Bureau completed the “Comprehensive Launch of Highway Service Area Charging Network” in August 2024, installing only fast chargers of 200 kW or higher, with 70 % rated at 350‑360 kW. In response to rising EV numbers, the bureau has prioritized expanding charging spots at Qingshui and Hukou service areas (north‑south stations) this year, adding four spots at each of the three stations for a total of 12 new spots. Qingshui’s expansion was completed and began operation in February 2024, bringing the total number of fast‑charging spots on national highways to 154.

Along the western main corridor, the Taiwan Provincial Highway 61 West Coast Expressway, the Highway Bureau has installed 13 fast‑charging units at Xin‑Feng, Da‑An, and Kou‑Lu rest areas. In the east, Taiwan Railways Administration launched the “Yihua‑Dong Charging Station Network” in July 2025, placing 20 public chargers across nine stations in Yilan, Hualien and Taitung along Highway 9 and adjacent railway stations, easing range anxiety for eastern EV drivers.

A Road Administration official said that as the public sector leads the rollout, the domestic EV charging environment is gradually improving, spurring robust growth in the private‑sector charging market. Data shows that 54 charging operators are now providing services, more than double the number recorded in Q3 2023.

Going forward, the MOTC will continue collaborating with other ministries and local governments to add more public chargers. Policy focus will shift from the initial “aggressive quantity expansion” phase to a “enhancing service quality” phase, ensuring charger availability and urging operators to implement proper management, thereby building a more convenient, reliable, and user‑friendly public charging network.

items.title: 華爾街最怕的不是AI泡沫 美債殖利率「失序飆升」成頭號風險
items.title_en: Wall Street’s Biggest Fear Isn’t an AI Bubble; a ‘Disordered Surge’ in U.S. Treasury Yields Is the Top Risk
paras: 全球基金經理人正面臨一項新的隱憂：債券殖利率可能「失序」飆升，引發市場劇烈波動，並進一步衝擊股市與整體經濟。
根據美國銀行(BAC-US) 9 月針對 170 名基金經理人的調查，受訪者合計管理資產規模達 4,700 億美元。淨 33% 的經理人目前將殖利率失控上升視為市場面臨的最大「尾部風險」，比 8 月的淨 27% 進一步攀升。
所謂尾部風險，是指發生機率偏低、但一旦出現可能造成重大衝擊的極端市場事件。
調查顯示，市場對借貸成本急升的憂慮，甚至已超越人工智慧（AI）交易形成泡沫的風險。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率周二升破 5.04%，為 2007 年全球金融危機以來首見。從德國到日本，各國指標公債殖利率也跟隨美債殖利率走高。
推升殖利率的因素之一，是市場對美國通膨的擔憂。隨著伊朗戰爭推高油價，通膨壓力再度升溫，加上投資人憂心政府債務與財政赤字持續擴大，以及企業大舉投入 AI 帶來額外債券供給，進一步加劇債市壓力。
聯準會（Fed）同樣難以置身事外。市場普遍預期，Fed 將在周三結束為期兩天的貨幣政策會議後宣布升息。
調查同時顯示，淨 46% 的基金經理人預期，美國財政部本月稍早宣布的債券買回計畫，對殖利率不會產生影響。
該計畫旨在維持全球最大債券市場順暢運作，並穩定長天期殖利率。認為計畫能夠奏效的受訪者僅淨 16%，另有 29% 預期計畫將完全失敗。
在市場交易方面，做多全球半導體股再度被視為最擁擠交易，高達淨 53% 的基金經理人持此看法；放空美國公債則以 18% 排名第二。費城半導體指數今年迄今已大漲 57%。
美銀指出，基金經理人已降低股票與大宗商品的加碼部位，但對債券仍維持大幅減碼。9 月資金轉向醫療保健、工業與銀行類股，其中銀行股加碼程度升至 2025 年 11 月以來最高。
相較之下，資金撤出不動產投資信託（REITs）與必需消費類股，目前對這兩類資產的減碼程度已升至 2004 年 1 月以來最高。
paras_en: Global fund managers are facing a new hidden worry: bond yields could ‘disorderly’ surge, triggering sharp market volatility and further hitting equities and the broader economy.

According to a September survey by Bank of America (BAC-US) of 170 fund managers overseeing a total of $470 billion in assets, a net 33% now view uncontrolled yield rises as the market’s biggest tail‑risk, up from a net 27% in August.
A tail‑risk refers to a low‑probability but potentially severe extreme market event.
The survey shows concern over rapidly rising borrowing costs has even eclipsed the risk of an AI‑driven trading bubble.

U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields broke above 5.04% on Tuesday, the first time since the 2007 global financial crisis, and benchmark yields in countries from Germany to Japan are climbing in step with U.S. yields.

One driver of the yield rise is lingering inflation worries in the United States. Higher oil prices from the Iran conflict, renewed inflation pressure, fears of expanding government debt and deficits, and a wave of corporate AI spending adding extra bond supply are all tightening the debt market.
The Federal Reserve can’t stay out of it either. Markets broadly expect the Fed to announce a rate hike after its two‑day policy meeting ends on Wednesday.
The survey also shows a net 46% of fund managers expect the Treasury’s bond‑buy‑back program announced earlier this month to have no impact on yields.
Only a net 16% believe the program will work, while 29% think it will completely fail.

In terms of trading, going long on global semiconductor stocks is again seen as the most crowded trade, with a net 53% of managers holding that view; shorting U.S. Treasuries ranks second at 18%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index is up 57% year‑to‑date.

Bank of America notes that managers have trimmed equity and commodity exposure but are still cutting bonds heavily. In September, capital shifted toward healthcare, industrials and banks, with bank allocations rising to their highest level since November 2025.
By contrast, money is flowing out of REITs and consumer‑staples stocks, with reductions in these two asset classes now at their strongest since January 2004.

items.title: 原油近月價差擴大！供應緊張警訊升高 布蘭特油價上看125美元
items.title_en: Brent Oil Prices Head Toward $125 as Near-Month Spread Widens
paras: 由於原油供應吃緊，世界各地買家如今若想立即取得一桶原油，必須支付更高價格，而非鎖定未來幾周或幾個月交貨的較低價格，這是能源市場可能難以跟上需求的警訊。

原油「近月價差」擴大　供應緊張疑慮升溫

近期美國汽油價格節節高升，目前平均價格為每加侖4.32美元，儘管仍低於2022年6月俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後曾創下的接近每加侖5.02美元紀錄，但美國駕駛人也可能需要做好未來幾周汽油價格上漲的準備。
原油價格上漲通常需要一段時間才會反映在零售汽油價格，但從原油市場的「近月價差」(prompt spread)來看，汽油帳單可能進一步增加。
近月價差指立即交割的原油價格，與數周後交割的原油價格之間的差距。今年夏季，由於停火以及美國與伊朗短暫達成外交協議，市場一度燃起衝突最糟情況可能已過的希望，近月價差曾經收窄，但如今兩者價差再次擴大。
全球基準原油、11月交割的布蘭特原油期貨周一(14日)一度升至每桶109.80美元，之後回落至約105.30美元。相比之下，12月交割、可晚一個月交貨的原油價格為每桶100.54美元。兩者價差約為每桶5.58美元，為7月23日以來最大價差。
西德州中級原油(WTI)10月交割期貨、也就是近月合約，周一徘徊在每桶103美元以上，但較11月的合約高出約每桶4.79美元，意味著所謂的近月價差也可能創下近兩個月最大水準。
這項價差顯示，市場對全球原油供應的疑慮升高，也反映市場對目前能立即取得的實體原油供應感到不安。
先前原油價格之所以能維持在可控制範圍，是因為中國在伊朗戰爭期間大幅放緩石油進口，且具有未公開的國內石油儲備。但中東衝突的規模與持續時間，已遠遠超市場先前預期。

沙國管線遭襲 兩大海上咽喉恐受控

由於沙烏地阿拉伯與獲伊朗支持的葉門胡塞武裝分子衝突升級，全球石油供應承受進一步壓力，全球與美國兩大原油基準價格因此攀抵四個月來最高水準。
沙烏地阿拉伯通往紅海的重要東西管線，周一在遭到多起無人機攻擊後仍處於關閉狀態，與此同時，伊朗代理人攻占紅海港口莫卡(Mokha)及一座戰略島嶼，使其部隊逼近曼德海峽，而這正是沙國原本可讓原油繞過荷姆茲海峽的要道。換言之，如今兩個關鍵海上咽喉都處於伊朗與胡塞武裝控制之下。
SPI Asset Management管理合夥人Stephen Innes說：「短暫中斷是可以應付的，但長時間關閉則是另一回事，因為原油只能回堵一段時間，之後物流限制就會開始影響生產——這就是計算從單純的不便，開始轉變為讓原油桶數退出市場的時刻。」
Innes指出，最接近交割的兩份布蘭特原油期貨合約之間的價差擴大，正反映這項疑慮，也顯示「買家為現在能取得的原油桶支付越來越高的價格」。
LPL Financial首席技術策略師Adam Turnquist認為，所有跡象都指向油價進一步上漲，目前「幾乎完全沒有任何與伊朗相關的進展」，包括衝突將持續多久、原油供應何時恢復正常、誰最終可能控制荷姆茲海峽，以及「這將付出什麼代價」，都仍缺乏明確答案。
從技術面來看，Turnquist表示，布蘭特原油上周突破約每桶100美元的夏季高點，下一個主要阻力位將上看春季高點、也就是超過每桶120美元的水準。
他說：「布蘭特原油下一個主要阻力區間將落在每桶112至125美元之間。」
paras_en: Because oil supply is tightening, buyers worldwide now have to pay higher prices to obtain a barrel of oil immediately, rather than locking in lower prices for delivery in a few weeks or months, signaling that the energy market may struggle to keep up with demand.

Oil’s near-month spread has widened, raising concerns about supply tightness. U.S. gasoline prices have been climbing steadily, averaging $4.32 per gallon. Although still below the nearly $5.02 per gallon record set in June 2022 after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, U.S. drivers may need to brace for further gasoline price increases in the coming weeks.
Oil price rises typically take time to reflect in retail gasoline prices, but the near-month spread in the oil market suggests that gasoline bills could rise further.

The near-month spread refers to the difference between the price of oil delivered immediately and the price of oil delivered a few weeks later. This summer, due to a cease‑fire and a brief diplomatic agreement between the U.S. and Iran, the market briefly revived hope that the worst of the conflict had passed, narrowing the spread. Today the spread has widened again.

Global benchmark crude and November‑delivery Brent futures rose to $109.80 per barrel on Monday (14th) before falling to about $105.30. In contrast, December‑delivery crude, which can be delivered a month later, traded at $100.54 per barrel. The spread between the two is about $5.58 per barrel, the largest since July 23.

West Texas Intermediate (WTI) October‑delivery futures, the near‑month contract, hovered above $103 per barrel on Monday, but were about $4.79 higher than the November contract, indicating that the near‑month spread may have reached its largest level in nearly two months.
This spread shows that market concerns about global crude supply have risen, reflecting unease about the immediate physical supply of crude that can be obtained now.

Oil prices had previously stayed within controllable limits because China slowed oil imports during the Iran war and had undisclosed domestic oil reserves. However, the scale and duration of the Middle East conflict far exceed earlier market expectations.

Saudi Arabia’s pipelines were attacked, and two major maritime chokepoints may be controlled. The escalation of conflict between Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthi forces supported by Iran has further pressured global oil supply, pushing both global and U.S. benchmark prices to their highest levels in four months.

The Saudi pipeline to the Red Sea’s east‑west route remained closed after multiple drone attacks on Monday. Meanwhile, Iranian proxies seized the Red Sea port of Mokha and a strategic island, bringing their forces close to the Strait of Mandab, which Saudi Arabia previously used to route oil around the Hodeidah Strait. In other words, both key maritime chokepoints are now under Iranian and Houthi control.

Stephen Innes, managing partner at SPI Asset Management, said: “Short‑term disruptions are manageable, but prolonged closures are another matter, because crude can only be blocked for a limited time before logistical constraints begin to affect production—this is when the inconvenience turns into a real exit of barrels from the market.”

Innes noted that the widening spread between the two nearest‑delivery Brent contracts reflects this concern and shows that buyers are paying increasingly higher prices for barrels of crude that can be obtained now.

Adam Turnquist, chief technical strategist at LPL Financial, believes all signs point to further oil price increases. He says there is “almost no progress related to Iran,” including how long the conflict will last, when supply will normalize, who will ultimately control the Hodeidah Strait, and “what the cost will be,” all remain unclear.

From a technical perspective, Turnquist said Brent crude last week broke through the summer high of about $100 per barrel. The next major resistance level will be the spring high, which is above $120 per barrel.
He added: “The next major resistance zone for Brent crude will be between $112 and $125 per barrel.”

items.title: 「升一次就停」沒戲了！逾半專家估Fed未來一年至少升息兩次
items.title_en: "One Hike and Stop" No Longer Expected: Over Half of Experts Forecast At Least Two Fed Rate Increases in the Next Year
paras: 「升一次就停」的期待可能落空。《CNBC》周二(15日)最新聯準會(Fed)調查顯示，多數受訪經濟學家、基金經理與策略師預測，Fed未來一年至少升息兩次，其中約三分之一甚至預期升息至少三次，反映油價飆升、通膨遲遲未降溫及Fed主席華許鷹派表態，已大幅改變市場利率展望。

通膨壓力擴散 多數受訪者預期不只升息一次

這項調查共有29人參與。上月僅46%受訪者預期Fed接下來會升息，如今比例已大增至86%；另有55%認為Fed未來一年將升息不只一次。
預期快速轉變，主要源自華許在傑克森霍爾年會發表鷹派演說、國際油價大漲，以及通膨未能持續降溫。受訪者也逐漸相信，物價壓力已從能源擴散至其他商品與服務，無法在Fed不採取行動的情況下自行消退。
Renaissance Macro Research研究主管Neil Dutta表示，目前沒有任何數據顯示通膨將「很快」回到目標。Nationwide首席美國經濟學家Kathy Bostjancic指出，油價、汽油與柴油價格再度攀升，加劇市場對能源成本外溢至其他商品、服務及通膨預期的擔憂。
約四分之三受訪者認為，目前通膨問題已不只侷限於能源價格。受訪者對2026年與2027年的消費者物價指數(CPI)預測均有所上調，預估今年平均通膨率將接近3.5%，2027年才降至2.85%。
多數受訪者同時預測，荷姆茲海峽至少還會封閉一個月，油價則可能維持高檔超過半年。不過，也有部分人士質疑，Fed升息能否有效壓低燃料供應受阻造成的通膨。Russell Investments資深投資組合經理Douglas Gordon表示，Fed的利率工具對供給面通膨影響有限，卻又必須展現維護物價穩定的公信力，政策操作將面臨兩難。
Fed將於周三結束兩天會議並公布利率決策，這也是7月以來首場聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議。

經濟展望仍穩健 市場肯定華許獨立性

儘管受訪者轉向預期Fed多次升息，經濟成長展望卻沒有明顯改變。未來12個月經濟衰退機率平均為29%，僅略高於正常水準；今年及明年國內生產毛額(GDP)成長率預估均約2.25%，高於2025年的2.1%，失業率則預估維持在4.25%左右。
美股展望同樣保持樂觀。受訪者預估標普500指數今年底將大致維持目前水準，2027年則可望上漲8%至8,274點。不過，Fed通常必須讓經濟成長低於潛在水準，才能有效降低通膨，因此多次升息、穩健成長與股市續漲能否同時實現，仍存在疑問。
Janney Montgomery Scott首席固定收益策略師Guy LeBas表示，美國經濟狀況與目前Fed政策利率並不相容，「不是通膨必須下降，就是Fed必須升息」，否則美債殖利率曲線長端將持續遭到拋售。
受訪者大致肯定華許的政策溝通與獨立性。59%認為他已充分說明經濟與貨幣政策觀點；69%認為政府要求降息不會影響本月決策；66%認為華許在執行貨幣政策時非常或大致獨立，但該比例較上次調查下降9個百分點。
僅31%受訪者認為Fed「說得太多」，遠低於7月的68%。此外，69%不贊成Fed定期提供前瞻指引，但59%支持公布政策反應函數，說明Fed將如何根據未來數據調整政策。受訪者認為，持續高通膨、伊朗戰事及高油價，是當前美國經濟擴張面臨的三大風險。
paras_en: The expectation of "one hike and stop" may be shattered. CNBC's latest Fed survey on Tuesday (the 15th) shows that most surveyed economists, fund managers and strategists now predict the Fed will raise rates at least twice in the coming year, with about a third even expecting three or more hikes, reflecting soaring oil prices, stubborn inflation and hawkish comments from Fed Chair Jerome Powell that have dramatically shifted market rate outlooks.

Inflation pressures are spreading and most respondents expect more than one hike. The survey included 29 participants. Last month only 46% of respondents thought the Fed would raise rates soon; that share has jumped to 86% today, and 55% now believe the Fed will raise rates more than once in the next year.

The rapid shift in expectations is driven mainly by Powell’s hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole symposium, the surge in global oil prices, and inflation’s failure to cool. Respondents are increasingly convinced that price pressures have moved beyond energy into other goods and services and will not dissipate without Fed action.

Neil Dutta, head of research at Renaissance Macro Research, said there is no data showing inflation will "quickly" return to target. Nationwide’s chief U.S. economist Kathy Bostjancic noted that rising oil, gasoline and diesel prices are heightening concerns that energy cost spillovers will feed into other goods, services and inflation expectations.

About three‑quarters of respondents say inflation is no longer confined to energy prices. They have nudged up their CPI forecasts for 2026 and 2027, expecting average inflation this year to hover near 3.5% and only fall to 2.85% by 2027.

Most respondents also expect the Strait of Hormuz to remain closed for at least another month, keeping oil prices high for more than six months. Some, however, question whether Fed hikes can effectively curb inflation caused by constrained fuel supply. Douglas Gordon, senior portfolio manager at Russell Investments, warned that the Fed’s rate tools have limited impact on supply‑side inflation yet must demonstrate credibility in price stability, putting policymakers in a dilemma.
The Fed will conclude its two‑day meeting on Wednesday and announce its rate decision, marking the first FOMC meeting since July.

Despite the shift toward multiple rate hikes, the outlook for economic growth remains steady. The average probability of a recession in the next 12 months is 29%, only slightly above normal. GDP growth is projected at about 2.25% for both this year and next, above the 2.1% forecast for 2025, while unemployment is expected to stay around 4.25%.

U.S. equity outlook stays optimistic. Respondents expect the S&P 500 to roughly hold its current level by year‑end and to rise to about 8,274 points by 2027, an 8% gain. However, the Fed typically must let growth run below potential to tame inflation, so whether multiple hikes, steady growth and continued stock gains can coexist remains uncertain.

Guy LeBas, chief fixed‑income strategist at Janney Montgomery Scott, said the U.S. economy and the current Fed policy rate are mismatched: "Either inflation must fall, or the Fed must hike," otherwise the long end of the Treasury yield curve will keep being sold off.

Respondents broadly affirm Powell’s policy communication and independence. Fifty‑nine percent say he has adequately explained his economic and monetary‑policy views; 69% believe government pressure to cut rates will not affect this month’s decision; 66% say Powell is very or fairly independent in implementing policy, though that share is down nine points from the previous survey.

Only 31% think the Fed "talks too much," far below July’s 68%. Moreover, 69% oppose regular forward guidance, while 59% support publishing a policy‑response function that shows how the Fed will adjust policy based on future data. Respondents cite persistent high inflation, the war in Iran and elevated oil prices as the three biggest risks to the current U.S. economic expansion.

items.title: 戰爭亂局變商機！阿聯石油巨擘低價掃貨伊拉克原油
items.title_en: War Turmoil Turns Into Business Opportunity! UAE Oil Giant Snaps Up Iraqi Crude at Low Prices
paras: 阿拉伯聯合大公國國營阿布達比國家石油公司(ADNOC)趁伊朗戰事干擾波斯灣原油供應之際，以每桶最高折讓27美元的價格，向伊拉克國營石油行銷公司(SOMO)採購數千萬桶原油，進一步擴大在國際石油交易市場的影響力。
三名知情人士透露，ADNOC透過旗下交易部門，成為8月及9月提取伊拉克原油數量最多的買家，也協助伊拉克出口量從戰事初期的低點回升。
其中一名伊拉克消息人士表示，ADNOC同意在8月採購3,200萬桶原油，每桶折讓24.9至27美元；9月再採購4,000萬桶，其中1,000萬桶每桶折讓18美元，其餘3,000萬桶折讓25美元。
不過，另一名消息人士指出，SOMO雖在8月向ADNOC分配3,200萬桶原油，但受到出口限制，以及巴士拉石油公司無法取得足夠原油影響，ADNOC實際僅提取2,000萬桶；9月至今則已提取1,400萬桶。另有消息人士稱，ADNOC透過招標購入約2,000萬桶、預定9月至10月裝運的伊拉克原油，每桶折讓25至27美元。
除ADNOC外，伊拉克原油的大幅折價也吸引中國石油(00857-HK)、振華石油、道達爾能源(TTE-US)、Vitol、Trafigura、Mercuria及國泰石油等買家進場。
伊拉克位於波斯灣最北端，又缺乏自有油輪船隊，戰事初期的原油出口因而大幅受限。伊朗上月在巴格達多次交涉後，批准數艘載運伊拉克原油的油輪通過荷姆茲海峽。

相較之下，ADNOC在戰事爆發後提高調度彈性，除了持續擴充油輪船隊，也利用通往富查伊拉港的輸油管，將原油運出波斯灣並繞過荷姆茲海峽。即使部分ADNOC油輪曾遭攻擊，伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)周日仍與阿布達比王儲哈立德(Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan)在新德里金磚國家峰會場邊會晤，並表示雙方同意放下過去的歧見。
Kpler數據顯示，伊拉克本月每日出口約200萬桶原油，低於8月的235.4萬桶，但高於7月的137.4萬桶。阿聯本月每日原油出口則升至323.6萬桶，高於8月的288.6萬桶及7月的287.1萬桶。
消息人士表示，ADNOC計劃將從其他波斯灣產油國採購的大部分原油，送往旗下魯韋斯煉油廠加工，藉此騰出更多自產原油銷往國際市場。
paras_en: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC), the state‑owned oil firm of the United Arab Emirates, took advantage of Iran‑related disruptions to Persian Gulf crude supplies by buying tens of millions of barrels from Iraq’s state‑run oil marketing company (SOMO) at discounts of up to $27 per barrel, further expanding its influence in the global oil market.

Three informed sources said ADNOC, through its trading arm, became the largest buyer of Iraqi crude in August and September and helped lift Iraq’s export volumes from the lows seen at the start of the conflict.

One Iraqi source said ADNOC agreed to purchase 32 million barrels in August at a discount of $24.9‑$27 per barrel, and to buy 40 million barrels in September, of which 10 million barrels would carry an $18 discount per barrel and the remaining 30 million barrels a $25 discount per barrel.

However, another source noted that although SOMO allocated 32 million barrels to ADNOC in August, export restrictions and the inability of Basra Oil Company to secure enough crude meant ADNOC actually lifted only 20 million barrels; from September to date it has lifted 14 million barrels. Another source said ADNOC bought about 20 million barrels through a tender for crude scheduled to be shipped in September‑October at a discount of $25‑$27 per barrel.
Besides ADNOC, the steep discount on Iraqi crude has attracted buyers such as China Petroleum (00857‑HK), Zhenhua Oil, TotalEnergies (TTE‑US), Vitol, Trafigura, Mercuria and Cathay Oil.

Iraq sits at the northern tip of the Persian Gulf and lacks its own tanker fleet, so crude exports were heavily constrained at the start of the war. After multiple talks in Baghdad last month, Iran approved several tankers carrying Iraqi crude to pass through the Hormuz Strait.

In contrast, ADNOC increased its scheduling flexibility after the conflict erupted, expanding its tanker fleet and using the pipeline to Fujairah port to move crude out of the Gulf while bypassing Hormuz. Even though some ADNOC tankers were attacked, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in New Delhi on Sunday and said the two sides agreed to set aside past differences.

Kpler data show Iraq exported about 2 million barrels per day this month, down from 2.354 million barrels in August but up from 1.374 million barrels in July. The UAE’s daily crude exports rose to 3.236 million barrels this month, higher than 2.886 million barrels in August and 2.871 million barrels in July.

Sources say ADNOC plans to send most of the crude it purchases from other Persian Gulf producers to its Ruwais refinery for processing, freeing up more of its own production for sale on the international market.

items.title: SpaceX、特斯拉要整併了？馬斯克一句話再掀猜測
items.title_en: Is SpaceX Merging with Tesla? Musk’s Remark Fuels More Speculation
paras: 馬斯克再度暗示，旗下人工智慧與火箭公司 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 可能與電動車製造商特斯拉(TSLA-US) 整併，並指出這兩家由他擔任執行長的公司，目前已在多個領域展開密切合作。
馬斯克透過視訊出席由多名與他關係密切的科技投資人主辦的「All-In Summit 2026」時，被問及特斯拉即將展示的新一代 Roadster 跑車。
馬斯克多年前曾表示，特斯拉將為 Roadster 提供「SpaceX 選配套件」，利用小型火箭推進器提升車輛加速性能與最高時速。
All-In 共同主持人之一 David Friedberg 隨後問道：「Elon，為什麼你現在還保留兩家獨立公司？」
馬斯克回答：「問得好。當雙方在這麼多領域都有如此密切的合作，誰能想像接下來可能會採取什麼行動？」
今年以來，市場對馬斯克可能整併 SpaceX 與特斯拉的揣測持續升溫。馬斯克旗下事業版圖近來經歷重大重整，SpaceX 今年 2 月收購人工智慧公司 xAI，合併後的公司並於 6 月上市，締造史上規模最大的首次公開募股（IPO）。
馬斯克也頻頻談及旗下企業之間的「融合」（convergence），進一步助長市場揣測。SpaceX 與特斯拉目前正共同推動名為「Terafab」的大型計畫，規劃在美國興建半導體製造廠，並以德州作為起點。
在馬斯克登場前，SpaceX 總裁 Gwynne Shotwell 親自出席 All-In Summit，活動共同主持人也拿 SpaceX 是否可能與特斯拉合併一事與她開玩笑。
在談到 SpaceX 收購 AI 程式開發新創 Cursor 後，另一名共同主持人 Jason Calacanis 問 Shotwell，公司接下來還打算收購哪些企業。Shotwell 僅回應「問得好」，未正面作答。
Friedberg 隨後以她是否喜歡電動車試探，Shotwell 則表示自己擁有好幾輛電動車，進一步為 SpaceX 與特斯拉可能整併的揣測增添話題。
paras_en: Musk hinted again that his artificial‑intelligence and rocket company SpaceX (SPCX‑US) could merge with electric‑vehicle maker Tesla (TSLA‑US), noting that the two firms he runs as CEO are already working closely together across multiple fields.
During a video appearance at the investor‑hosted All‑In Summit 2026, Musk was asked about the next‑generation Roadster that Tesla will unveil.
Musk had said years ago that the Roadster would feature a “SpaceX‑compatible package,” using a small rocket thruster to boost acceleration and top speed.
One of the All‑In co‑hosts, David Friedberg, then asked, “Elon, why do you still keep two separate companies?”
Musk replied, “Good question. When the two are collaborating so closely in so many areas, who can imagine what might come next?”

Since the start of the year, market speculation about a possible SpaceX‑Tesla merger has heated up. Musk’s empire has undergone major reshuffling, with SpaceX acquiring AI firm xAI in February and the combined entity going public in June in the largest IPO ever recorded.

Musk has also repeatedly spoken of “convergence” among his businesses, further stoking rumors. SpaceX and Tesla are jointly pushing a massive project called “Terafab,” planning to build a semiconductor fab in the United States, starting in Texas.
Before Musk took the stage, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell attended the All‑In Summit, and the co‑hosts teased her about whether SpaceX might merge with Tesla.

After discussing SpaceX’s acquisition of AI‑software startup Cursor, co‑host Jason Calacanis asked Shotwell what other companies the firm might acquire next. Shotwell simply replied, “Good question,” without giving a direct answer.
Friedberg then probed whether Shotwell liked electric cars; Shotwell said she owned several EVs, adding more fodder to the speculation about a possible SpaceX‑Tesla merger.

items.title: 10年期殖利率若跨過5.25%一切都變了！美債恐不再是股市避風港
items.title_en: If the 10-Year Yield Crosses 5.25%, Everything Changes! U.S. Treasuries May Lose Their Safe‑Haven Role for Stocks
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率本周突破5%，並一度升至2007年來最高，距離可能改變全球市場運作模式的5.25%關卡愈來愈近。歷史經驗顯示，一旦殖利率長時間高於5.25%，股票與債券往往不再互相避險，反而同步漲跌，進一步推升股債波動率並擴大信用利差。
《彭博》宏觀策略師Simon White指出，金融市場很少存在如此明確的分界線。當美國10年期公債殖利率高於5.25%時，標普500指數與美債呈現負相關的情況幾乎不曾出現，意味投資組合可能失去最重要的避險機制。

5.25%成市場分水嶺 美債恐失去避險功能

股票與債券呈現負相關時，股市下跌通常伴隨債券價格上漲，可協助投資人降低整體損失。但若兩者轉為正相關，股債便可能同時下跌，美債不但無法保護投資組合，還會進一步放大股票虧損。
股票與債券的相關性從2022年至2025年底大致維持正值，即使當時殖利率低於5.25%；今年以來則接近零。若殖利率繼續攀升，兩者很可能再度明確轉為正相關。
2000年代及2010年代被稱為「低通膨、經濟持續擴張」時期(Non-Inflationary Continuous Expansion, NICE)，經濟成長衝擊通常會壓低通膨，股票與債券因而長期呈現負相關，美債也是可靠的股票避險工具。然而，從更長期歷史來看，股債同步漲跌才是常態。
當前環境正逐漸回到這種模式。經濟成長放緩可能與通膨衝擊同時發生，導致股票因獲利前景轉弱而下跌，債券也因物價壓力升高而遭到拋售。此時，美債將變成所謂的「德州式避險」——名義上是避險工具，實際上卻增加投資組合風險。
儘管美債殖利率已升至近20年高點，市場仍未進入明顯超賣狀態。若以包含孳息的報酬及債券價格年增率衡量，美債目前只是回到長期平均水準。由於債券價格通常會在均值回歸後進一步超跌，美債賣壓可能尚未結束。

股債波動相互放大 信用市場也難以倖免

美債失去避險功能後，第一個受害者將是債券市場波動率。當投資人不再把美債視為可靠避險資產，邊際買家將對價格更加敏感，市場也更容易受到資金流向影響。投資人還可能轉向利用選擇權避險，進一步推高隱含波動率。
債券波動升高也會向股市傳導。股債同步放大漲跌後，資產配置基金的再平衡資金流將更加不穩定，推升華爾街恐慌指數(VIX)。此外，由於債券無法有效對沖股票風險，投資人可能增加股票選擇權避險，使股市隱含波動率進一步上升。
另一項風險來自企業估值。債券波動愈大，投資人用來計算未來現金流價值的折現率就愈不確定，尤其不利高估值與長天期成長股。目前個股間相關性仍處於歷史低檔，暫時抑制個股波動向VIX傳導；但一旦相關性回升，指數波動可能迅速擴大。
信用市場同樣難以置身事外。低迷的股市波動率是目前信用利差保持狹窄的重要原因，而高收益債利差通常與VIX同步變動。若債券波動帶動VIX上升，企業信用利差也可能擴大，使企業融資成本面臨另一波壓力。

通膨支撐殖利率 Fed升息反而可能吸引買盤

市場能否避免進入新的高波動階段，將取決於這波美債拋售是否接近尾聲。部分AI實驗室呼籲放慢模型開發，可能為削減資本支出提供理由，並對經濟成長形成壓力；但大量算力「照付不議」合約已延伸至明年甚至更久，短期內未必足以促使美債反彈。
若殖利率持續高於5%，長期資金或為房貸抵押證券避險的投資人可能進場買進，但目前尚未出現明顯行動，影響也可能只是暫時。與此同時，大宗商品漲勢持續，中東及俄羅斯的能源與糧食供應干擾仍未改善。即使未來數月通膨可能暫時降溫，結構性物價壓力依然存在，將持續為殖利率提供上升動力。
在周三聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議前，投資人大舉進場承接美債的意願可能有限。弔詭的是，如果聯準會(Fed)升息，並讓市場相信其有決心壓制通膨，反而可能吸引美債買盤；若Fed按兵不動，投資人對通膨與政策公信力的疑慮可能升高，進一步推升長天期殖利率。
美債正逼近關鍵轉折點。若10年期殖利率明顯突破5.25%，並維持一段時間，股債同步下跌、波動率攀升及信用利差擴大的市場環境，可能取代過去以債券對沖股票風險的投資模式。
paras_en: U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields broke the 5% mark this week and briefly rose to the highest level since 2007, edging ever closer to the 5.25% threshold that could reshape global market dynamics. History shows that when yields stay above 5.25% for a prolonged period, stocks and bonds cease to hedge each other and tend to move together, boosting equity‑bond volatility and widening credit spreads.

Bloomberg macro strategist Simon White notes that financial markets rarely exhibit such a clear dividing line. When the U.S. 10‑year yield exceeds 5.25%, the negative correlation between the S&P 500 and Treasuries virtually disappears, meaning portfolios may lose their most important hedge mechanism.

A 5.25% yield acts as a market watershed; Treasuries risk losing their hedge function. When stocks and bonds are negatively correlated, a stock market decline is usually offset by rising bond prices, helping investors limit overall losses. If the correlation flips positive, equities and bonds can fall together, and Treasuries not only fail to protect portfolios but also amplify equity losses.

From 2022 through the end of 2025, the equity‑bond correlation stayed modestly positive even though yields were below 5.25%; this year it has hovered near zero. If yields keep climbing, the two asset classes are likely to revert to a clear positive correlation.

The 2000s and 2010s have been described as a period of “Non‑Inflationary Continuous Expansion” (NICE), when economic‑growth shocks tended to suppress inflation, keeping stocks and bonds negatively correlated and Treasuries a reliable equity hedge. Yet a longer‑term view shows that simultaneous moves in stocks and bonds are the norm.

The current environment is gradually returning to that pattern. Slowing growth may coincide with inflationary pressure, causing equities to fall on weaker earnings outlooks while bonds are sold off as price pressures rise. In this setting, Treasuries become a “Texas‑style hedge” – nominally a hedge but in practice adding risk to portfolios.

Even though Treasury yields have risen to near‑20‑year highs, the market has not entered a clear oversold condition. Measured by total return including yield and the annual price appreciation of bonds, Treasuries are merely back at their long‑run average. Because bond prices often overshoot on mean‑reversion, selling pressure on Treasuries may not be over yet.

When Treasuries lose their hedge function, the first victim will be bond‑market volatility. Investors will no longer view Treasuries as a safe asset, making marginal buyers more price‑sensitive and the market more prone to capital‑flow swings. Investors may also shift to using options for hedging, pushing implied volatility higher.

Higher bond volatility feeds back into equities. When stocks and bonds move together, asset‑allocation funds’ rebalancing flows become more erratic, lifting the VIX. Moreover, because bonds can no longer effectively offset equity risk, investors may increase equity‑option hedges, further raising implied equity volatility.

Another risk comes from equity valuations. Greater bond‑market volatility makes the discount rate used to value future cash flows more uncertain, hurting high‑valuation and long‑duration growth stocks. At present, individual‑stock correlations are at historic lows, temporarily dampening the transmission of stock volatility to the VIX; but if correlations rise, index volatility could expand rapidly.

The credit market is not insulated either. Low equity‑market volatility is a key reason credit spreads remain narrow today, and high‑yield spreads usually move in step with the VIX. If bond volatility lifts the VIX, corporate credit spreads could widen, adding another pressure on financing costs.

Whether the market can avoid a new high‑volatility phase will depend on whether the current Treasury sell‑off is nearing its end. Some AI labs are calling for slower model development, which could justify cutting capex and weigh on growth; however, large‑scale compute contracts billed “pay‑as‑you‑go” have been extended into next year and beyond, so a short‑term rebound in Treasuries is not guaranteed.

If yields stay above 5%, long‑term investors who use mortgage‑backed securities as a hedge might start buying, but no clear buying wave has emerged yet and any impact may be temporary. Meanwhile, commodity prices keep rising, and disruptions to energy and grain supplies from the Middle East and Russia remain unresolved. Even if inflation cools briefly in the coming months, structural price pressures persist, continuing to support higher yields.

Ahead of Wednesday’s Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, investor appetite to take on more Treasuries may be limited. Paradoxically, if the Fed raises rates and convinces the market it is serious about taming inflation, that could attract Treasury buying; if the Fed holds steady, doubts about inflation and policy credibility could rise, pushing long‑term yields higher.

Treasuries are approaching a critical turning point. If the 10‑year yield clearly breaks through 5.25% and stays there for a while, a market environment of simultaneous equity‑bond declines, rising volatility and widening credit spreads could replace the previous model of using bonds to hedge equity risk.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉油價與美債殖利率同步攀升 主要指數開盤走勢低迷
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Flat as Oil Prices and Treasury Yields Rise
paras: 美股主要指數周二(15日)開盤走勢低迷，在平盤附近偏弱震盪。國際油價持續攀升，加劇市場對通膨的擔憂並向債市施壓，美國10年期公債殖利率觸及19年新高，抑制投資人風險偏好。與此同時，市場對AI需求前景仍存疑慮，交易員也不敢在聯準會(Fed)周三公布利率決策前大舉進場。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近300點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近50點或近0.2%，標普 500 指數跌近0.2%，費城半導體指數漲近0.9%。台積電 ADR 跌0.2%。
油價維持高檔加劇通膨疑慮，美債賣壓周二持續升高，美國10年期公債殖利率一度上升4個基點，觸及19年來最高水準，壓抑市場風險偏好。美股主要指數周二盤前走低，標普500指數期貨下跌0.1%。
布蘭特原油逼近每桶107美元，9月迄今累計上漲18%，使投資人更加關注能源成本上升與政府債務膨脹的影響。美元則可望連續第二個交易日走強。由於市場對美國加密貨幣監管法案短期取得進展的期待消退，比特幣回落，相關加密貨幣概念股盤前同步走低。
高檔債券殖利率正主導市場走勢，並對科技與成長股形成壓力。今年支撐美股上漲的AI交易也有所降溫，市場持續爭論AI是否可能造成災難性危害。Societe de Gestion Prevoir基金經理Louis Puga表示，企業資產負債表與獲利依然健康，但各國政府龐大赤字正從另一端向債市施壓。
債市疲弱也提高聯準會(Fed)周三利率決策的重要性。利率期貨顯示，交易員預估Fed升息的機率超過90%。若Fed意外按兵不動，或暗示緊縮幅度低於市場預期，投資人可能因通膨風險要求更高的殖利率。
安聯環球投資分析師Jenny Zeng表示，通膨多年高於目標後，Fed的公信力正受到檢視。Fed主席華許近期談話幾乎沒有留下疑問，恢復物價穩定仍是首要任務，9月會議將成為這項承諾的關鍵考驗。
歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.2%。德意志銀行(DB-US)下挫1.9%，延續美國同業的疲弱走勢；此前美國銀行(BAC-US)警告，本季交易業務營收可能持平。市場人士認為，股市若要恢復上漲，除了Fed須提供更清晰的政策方向，企業第三季財報也必須維持強勁。
亞洲方面，日本政府考慮將中期國防支出目標提高至國內生產毛額(GDP)的3.5%，賣壓集中在長天期公債。MSCI(MSCI-US)亞太股市指數連續第四個交易日下跌，創5月以來最長跌勢，約四分之三成分股走低。

paras_en: U.S. equity indices opened flat on Tuesday (the 15th), trading weakly near the flat line. International oil prices kept climbing, heightening inflation concerns and pressuring the bond market, with the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield hitting a 19‑year high and dampening investors’ risk appetite. At the same time, doubts remain about AI demand, and traders are reluctant to make big moves before the Fed’s rate decision on Wednesday.

Before the close, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down about 300 points, or roughly 0.5%, the Nasdaq Composite fell about 50 points, or about 0.2%, the S&P 500 slipped about 0.2%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose about 0.9%. TSMC ADR fell 0.2%.

Oil’s high‑price environment is feeding inflation worries, and Treasury selling pressure rose on Tuesday, with the U.S. 10‑year yield briefly up four basis points to a 19‑year peak, curbing market risk appetite. U.S. equity indices were lower in pre‑market trading, with S&P 500 futures down 0.1%.

Brent crude is approaching $107 a barrel, up 18% since the start of September, prompting investors to focus on rising energy costs and expanding government debt. The dollar is set for a second consecutive day of strength. With expectations fading that the U.S. crypto‑regulation bill would make short‑term progress, Bitcoin fell and crypto‑related stocks slipped in pre‑market trading.

High‑yielding bonds are dominating market direction and weighing on tech and growth stocks. AI‑driven trading that has supported U.S. equity gains this year is cooling, and the market continues to debate whether AI could pose catastrophic risks. Louis Puga, fund manager at Societe de Gestion Prevoir, said corporate balance sheets and earnings remain healthy, but massive fiscal deficits worldwide are pressuring the bond market from the other side.

Weakness in the bond market also raises the importance of the Fed’s rate decision on Wednesday. Rate‑futures show traders assign more than a 90% probability to a Fed hike. If the Fed unexpectedly holds rates steady or signals a smaller tightening than expected, investors may demand even higher yields to compensate for inflation risk.

Allianz Global Investors analyst Jenny Zeng said that after years of inflation running above target, the Fed’s credibility is under scrutiny. Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s recent remarks left little doubt that restoring price stability remains the top priority, and the September meeting will be a key test of that commitment.

Europe’s Stoxx 600 slipped 0.2%. Deutsche Bank fell 1.9%, following the weak trend in U.S. peers; earlier, Bank of America warned that its quarterly trading revenue could be flat. Market participants think that for equities to resume gains, the Fed must provide clearer policy guidance and Q3 corporate earnings must stay strong.

In Asia, the Japanese government is considering raising its medium‑term defense‑spending target to 3.5% of GDP, putting selling pressure on long‑dated Japanese bonds. The MSCI Asia‑Pacific index fell for the fourth consecutive session, the longest decline since May, with roughly three‑quarters of its constituents lower.

Gold slipped further ahead of the Fed decision, breaking below $4,300 an ounce. Because gold yields no income, higher rates usually erode its appeal. Bloomberg strategist Simon White warned that Treasury yields are approaching a turning point, and stocks and bonds could start amplifying portfolio risk together, ushering in a new phase of simultaneous equity‑bond volatility and widening credit spreads.

items.title: 美股漲不動了？富國銀行估標普500年底僅剩1%上漲空間
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Stalling? Wells Fargo Cuts S&P 500 Year‑End Upside to 1%
paras: 富國銀行(WFC-US)將標普500指數今年底目標由7,950點下調至7,700點，理由是市場進一步上漲的催化劑有限，加上政治及特定產業風險升高，使後市展望蒙上陰影。新目標僅較指數最近收盤的7,619.98點高約1%，也低於多家華爾街機構預測的年底突破8,000點。
富國銀行在9月14日報告中表示，美股正進入景氣循環的「後半場」，這個階段通常意味市場本益比將下滑。儘管如此，該行仍將標普500成分股2027年每股盈餘預估由395美元上調至425美元，2028年預估則由425美元提高至460美元，但警告若AI基礎設施支出放緩，2028年獲利可能面臨下修風險。
標普500今年以來已上漲11.3%，期間挺過中東緊張局勢，以及通膨居高不下可能迫使聯準會(Fed)維持鷹派更長時間的疑慮。倫敦證交所集團(LSEG-UK)彙整數據顯示，已公布第二季財報的496家標普500企業中，有85.7%的獲利優於分析師預期。
美國銀行(BAC-US)旗下BofA Global Research周一也將標普500年底目標由7,100點上調至7,400點，但仍低於華爾街共識，並警告市場進入季節性疲弱時期，回檔可能早已該發生。
在產業配置方面，富國銀行將美國科技業評等由「加碼」下調至「中立」，並將醫療保健業由「中立」上調至「加碼」。此次調整緊接在科技股周一遭到拋售之後，多家AI領導企業因安全疑慮呼籲放慢技術開發。富國銀行也指出，期中選舉可能成為科技業的新風險，尤其反對資料中心建設的政治聲浪正持續升高。
paras_en: Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) lowered its year‑end target for the S&P 500 from 7,950 points to 7,700 points, saying that there are few catalysts for further market gains and that rising political and sector‑specific risks have clouded the outlook. The new target is only about 1% above the index’s recent close of 7,619.98 points and falls short of most Wall Street forecasts for a year‑end breach of 8,000 points.

In a September 14 report, the bank said U.S. equities are entering the “second half” of the economic cycle, a phase that typically sees a decline in market price‑to‑earnings multiples. Nevertheless, Wells Fargo raised its 2027 earnings‑per‑share estimate for S&P 500 constituents from $395 to $425 and its 2028 estimate from $425 to $460, while warning that a slowdown in AI‑related infrastructure spending could force a profit revision for 2028.

The S&P 500 has risen 11.3% so far this year, weathering Middle‑East tensions and concerns that stubborn inflation could keep the Fed hawkish for longer. Data compiled by the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG‑UK) show that 85.7% of the 496 S&P 500 companies that have reported Q2 results posted earnings above analyst expectations.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) through its BofA Global Research raised its year‑end S&P 500 target on Monday from 7,100 points to 7,400 points, still below the Wall Street consensus, and warned that the market is entering a seasonal weakness period, meaning a pull‑back may already be imminent.

In sector positioning, Wells Fargo downgraded its rating on U.S. technology from “overweight” to “neutral” and upgraded healthcare from “neutral” to “overweight.” The move follows Monday’s sell‑off in tech stocks, as several AI leaders faced safety concerns and calls to slow development. The bank also noted that the upcoming midterm elections could pose a new risk for tech, with growing political opposition to data‑center construction.

items.title: 美國救日元其實是在救自己？貝森特揭保出口、防拋美債盤算
items.title_en: Is the U.S. Saving the Yen Actually Saving Itself? Bessent Reveals Export Support and Calculated Avoidance of Selling U.S. Debt
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(15日)表示，美國7月底與日本聯手干預匯市時，只動用「象徵性」資金買進日元，但這項行動符合美國利益，不僅有利美國出口，也可避免日本為支撐日元而出售美國資產。
貝森特在眾議院金融服務委員會聽證會上表示，日元走強有利美國出口，也代表日本政府不必出售美國資產籌措干預匯市所需資金。日本是美國公債最大海外持有國，若東京大量出售美元資產，尤其是美債，可能進一步推升美國借貸成本。
日元先前跌至40年來最低後，美國財政部於7月31日加入日本買進日元。市場人士推算，美方此次動用資金明顯不到10億美元，遠低於日本政府從7月底至8月底投入的創紀錄964億美元。
貝森特表示，美國只需投入少量資金，就成功釋出支持日本匯率政策的訊號。獲利雖非這次行動的目標，但美國財政部仍從日元交易中賺進數千萬美元。
近幾周以來，貝森特也多次暗示，希望日本銀行(日本央行/BOJ)透過升息支撐日元，並透露自己對日本貨幣政策走向的掌握，也是決定干預匯市的因素之一。BOJ將於本周稍晚召開利率決策會議。
貝森特上周在德州南方衛理會大學一場活動中更直接向交易員喊話：「現在莊家是我。」他表示，美國介入日元市場時，對BOJ及日本決策官員下一步行動有相當深入的了解，「如果你想跟我對賭，也可以試試看」。
貝森特上月回覆民主黨參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)質詢時則指出，日元市場若出現失序波動，可能引發投資人被迫平倉，不僅會動搖全球金融市場，最終還可能提高美國家庭與企業的借貸成本。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday the 15th that when the United States teamed up with Japan at the end of July to intervene in the foreign‑exchange market, it used only “symbolic” funds to buy yen, but the move serves U.S. interests, boosting American exports and preventing Japan from having to sell U.S. assets to support the yen.

Bessent told a hearing of the House Financial Services Committee that a stronger yen benefits U.S. exporters and means the Japanese government does not have to sell U.S. assets to raise the cash needed for currency intervention. Japan is the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasury bonds, and a large‑scale sale of dollar assets—especially Treasuries—by Tokyo could push up U.S. borrowing costs further.

After the yen fell to a 40‑year low, the U.S. Treasury joined Japan in buying yen on July 31. Market estimates put the amount of U.S. funds used at well under $1 billion, far less than the record‑setting ¥96.4 billion (about $964 million) that the Japanese government deployed from the end of July through the end of August.

Bessent said the United States needed only a modest amount of money to send a clear signal of support for Japan’s exchange‑rate policy. While profit was not the goal of the operation, the Treasury still earned several tens of millions of dollars from the yen trades.

In recent weeks Bessent has repeatedly hinted that he hopes the Bank of Japan will raise rates to support the yen and disclosed that his grasp of Japan’s monetary‑policy direction is one of the factors behind the decision to intervene. The BOJ is slated to hold its rate‑policy meeting later this week.

At an event last week at Southern Methodist University in Texas, Bessent told traders directly, “I’m the house now.” He said the United States’ yen intervention gave it deep insight into the BOJ’s and Japanese officials’ next moves, adding, “If you want to bet against me, you can try.”

When Bessent answered a question from Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren last month, he warned that disorderly swings in the yen market could force investors to liquidate positions, destabilize global financial markets and ultimately raise borrowing costs for U.S. households and businesses.

items.title: 華爾街最怕的不是AI泡沫 美債殖利率「失序飆升」成頭號風險
items.title_en: Wall Street’s Biggest Fear Isn’t an AI Bubble; a ‘Disordered Surge’ in U.S. Treasury Yields Is the Top Risk
paras: 全球基金經理人正面臨一項新的隱憂：債券殖利率可能「失序」飆升，引發市場劇烈波動，並進一步衝擊股市與整體經濟。
根據美國銀行(BAC-US) 9 月針對 170 名基金經理人的調查，受訪者合計管理資產規模達 4,700 億美元。淨 33% 的經理人目前將殖利率失控上升視為市場面臨的最大「尾部風險」，比 8 月的淨 27% 進一步攀升。
所謂尾部風險，是指發生機率偏低、但一旦出現可能造成重大衝擊的極端市場事件。
調查顯示，市場對借貸成本急升的憂慮，甚至已超越人工智慧（AI）交易形成泡沫的風險。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率周二升破 5.04%，為 2007 年全球金融危機以來首見。從德國到日本，各國指標公債殖利率也跟隨美債殖利率走高。
推升殖利率的因素之一，是市場對美國通膨的擔憂。隨著伊朗戰爭推高油價，通膨壓力再度升溫，加上投資人憂心政府債務與財政赤字持續擴大，以及企業大舉投入 AI 帶來額外債券供給，進一步加劇債市壓力。
聯準會（Fed）同樣難以置身事外。市場普遍預期，Fed 將在周三結束為期兩天的貨幣政策會議後宣布升息。
調查同時顯示，淨 46% 的基金經理人預期，美國財政部本月稍早宣布的債券買回計畫，對殖利率不會產生影響。
該計畫旨在維持全球最大債券市場順暢運作，並穩定長天期殖利率。認為計畫能夠奏效的受訪者僅淨 16%，另有 29% 預期計畫將完全失敗。
在市場交易方面，做多全球半導體股再度被視為最擁擠交易，高達淨 53% 的基金經理人持此看法；放空美國公債則以 18% 排名第二。費城半導體指數今年迄今已大漲 57%。
美銀指出，基金經理人已降低股票與大宗商品的加碼部位，但對債券仍維持大幅減碼。9 月資金轉向醫療保健、工業與銀行類股，其中銀行股加碼程度升至 2025 年 11 月以來最高。
相較之下，資金撤出不動產投資信託（REITs）與必需消費類股，目前對這兩類資產的減碼程度已升至 2004 年 1 月以來最高。
paras_en: Global fund managers are facing a new hidden worry: bond yields could ‘disorderly’ surge, triggering sharp market volatility and further hitting equities and the broader economy.

According to a September survey by Bank of America (BAC-US) of 170 fund managers overseeing a total of $470 billion in assets, a net 33% now view uncontrolled yield rises as the market’s biggest tail‑risk, up from a net 27% in August.
A tail‑risk refers to a low‑probability but potentially severe extreme market event.
The survey shows concern over rapidly rising borrowing costs has even eclipsed the risk of an AI‑driven trading bubble.

U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields broke above 5.04% on Tuesday, the first time since the 2007 global financial crisis, and benchmark yields in countries from Germany to Japan are climbing in step with U.S. yields.

One driver of the yield rise is lingering inflation worries in the United States. Higher oil prices from the Iran conflict, renewed inflation pressure, fears of expanding government debt and deficits, and a wave of corporate AI spending adding extra bond supply are all tightening the debt market.
The Federal Reserve can’t stay out of it either. Markets broadly expect the Fed to announce a rate hike after its two‑day policy meeting ends on Wednesday.
The survey also shows a net 46% of fund managers expect the Treasury’s bond‑buy‑back program announced earlier this month to have no impact on yields.
Only a net 16% believe the program will work, while 29% think it will completely fail.

In terms of trading, going long on global semiconductor stocks is again seen as the most crowded trade, with a net 53% of managers holding that view; shorting U.S. Treasuries ranks second at 18%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index is up 57% year‑to‑date.

Bank of America notes that managers have trimmed equity and commodity exposure but are still cutting bonds heavily. In September, capital shifted toward healthcare, industrials and banks, with bank allocations rising to their highest level since November 2025.
By contrast, money is flowing out of REITs and consumer‑staples stocks, with reductions in these two asset classes now at their strongest since January 2004.

items.title: 競爭先放一邊！OpenAI攜手Anthropic、Google防範AI災難性風險
items.title_en: Putting Competition Aside! OpenAI Teams Up with Anthropic and Google to Guard Against AI Catastrophic Risks
paras: OpenAI表示，正與主要競爭對手Anthropic及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google DeepMind合作研擬AI安全措施，回應外界日益擔憂AI可能對經濟與國家安全構成威脅。OpenAI全球政策主管Chris Lehane指出，三家公司已就相關議題接觸數周，且不認為合作處理安全問題需要取得反壟斷豁免。
Lehane周二(15日)在華府簡報會上表示，業者共同把安全列為優先事項，將比各自為政更好，航空業等產業也有企業為安全目的相互合作的先例。
這波AI風險爭論源自Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)周六發表的一篇3,800字長文。他呼籲放慢最先進AI系統的開發速度，讓研究人員有更多時間了解潛在威脅。這項主張迅速獲得OpenAI執行長阿特曼(Sam Altman)及SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)支持。Anthropic與Google DeepMind尚未回應置評請求。
Lehane此次前往華府與國會議員會面，並表示OpenAI支持兩黨共同提出、旨在防範AI災難性風險的法案，只要有機會通過，公司都願意配合。
OpenAI支持的方案包括由共和黨眾議員Jay Obernolte及民主黨眾議員Lori Trahan提出的聯邦AI治理架構。公司也對參議院多數黨領袖John Thune、共和黨參議員Ted Cruz及民主黨參議員Amy Klobuchar正在研擬的跨黨派提案持開放態度。
另有議員提案給予AI公司範圍有限的反壟斷豁免，允許業者針對AI系統失控、網路或生物威脅，以及中國企業竊取資料等風險交換資訊。相關條文已被納入年度國防法案。
不過，國會年底前通過AI法案的機率仍低。眾議院預計周四離開華府，直到11月選舉後才復會；選後短暫會期的重點則可能放在提高五角大廈預算。
川普也強烈反對限制AI發展。他周一連續在社群媒體發文，批評Anthropic與OpenAI推動放慢尖端AI開發，並將有關AI生存威脅的警告斥為「騙局」。這意味科技巨擘即使建立安全合作機制，仍將面臨白宮與國會的政治阻力。
paras_en: OpenAI said it is working with major rival Anthropic and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) subsidiary Google DeepMind to develop AI safety measures in response to growing concerns that AI could threaten the economy and national security. OpenAI’s global policy chief Chris Lehane noted the three companies have been in contact on the issue for several weeks and do not believe a antitrust exemption is needed for collaborative safety work.

Lehane told a briefing in Washington on Tuesday (the 15th) that industry players prioritising safety together is better than acting alone, citing precedents in sectors such as aviation where companies cooperate for safety purposes.

The AI‑risk debate was sparked by a 3,800‑word essay published on Saturday by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who urged a slowdown in the development of the most advanced AI systems to give researchers more time to understand potential threats. The call quickly gained support from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX AI chief Elon Musk. Anthropic and Google DeepMind have not responded to comment requests.
Lehane travelled to Washington to meet with members of Congress and said OpenAI backs a bipartisan bill aimed at preventing catastrophic AI risks and will cooperate with any legislation that passes.

The proposals OpenAI supports include a federal AI governance framework introduced by Republican Representative Jay Obernolte and Democratic Representative Lori Trahan. The company is also open to the bipartisan proposals being crafted by Senate Majority Leader John Thune, Republican Senator Ted Cruz and Democratic Senator Amy Klobuchar.

Another legislator has proposed a limited antitrust exemption for AI firms, allowing them to share information on risks such as loss of control over AI systems, cyber or bio threats, and data theft by Chinese companies. The language has been incorporated into the annual defense authorization bill.

However, the odds of Congress passing an AI bill before the end of the year remain low. The House is expected to leave Washington on Thursday and not reconvene until after the November election; the short post‑election session will likely focus on boosting the Pentagon’s budget.

President Trump also strongly opposes limiting AI development. He posted on social media on Monday, criticizing Anthropic and OpenAI for urging a slowdown of cutting‑edge AI work and dismissing warnings about AI existential threats as a “hoax.” This suggests that even if tech giants establish safety collaborations, they will still face political resistance from the White House and Congress.

items.title: 原油近月價差擴大！供應緊張警訊升高 布蘭特油價上看125美元
items.title_en: Brent Oil Prices Head Toward $125 as Near-Month Spread Widens
paras: 由於原油供應吃緊，世界各地買家如今若想立即取得一桶原油，必須支付更高價格，而非鎖定未來幾周或幾個月交貨的較低價格，這是能源市場可能難以跟上需求的警訊。

原油「近月價差」擴大　供應緊張疑慮升溫

近期美國汽油價格節節高升，目前平均價格為每加侖4.32美元，儘管仍低於2022年6月俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後曾創下的接近每加侖5.02美元紀錄，但美國駕駛人也可能需要做好未來幾周汽油價格上漲的準備。
原油價格上漲通常需要一段時間才會反映在零售汽油價格，但從原油市場的「近月價差」(prompt spread)來看，汽油帳單可能進一步增加。
近月價差指立即交割的原油價格，與數周後交割的原油價格之間的差距。今年夏季，由於停火以及美國與伊朗短暫達成外交協議，市場一度燃起衝突最糟情況可能已過的希望，近月價差曾經收窄，但如今兩者價差再次擴大。
全球基準原油、11月交割的布蘭特原油期貨周一(14日)一度升至每桶109.80美元，之後回落至約105.30美元。相比之下，12月交割、可晚一個月交貨的原油價格為每桶100.54美元。兩者價差約為每桶5.58美元，為7月23日以來最大價差。
西德州中級原油(WTI)10月交割期貨、也就是近月合約，周一徘徊在每桶103美元以上，但較11月的合約高出約每桶4.79美元，意味著所謂的近月價差也可能創下近兩個月最大水準。
這項價差顯示，市場對全球原油供應的疑慮升高，也反映市場對目前能立即取得的實體原油供應感到不安。
先前原油價格之所以能維持在可控制範圍，是因為中國在伊朗戰爭期間大幅放緩石油進口，且具有未公開的國內石油儲備。但中東衝突的規模與持續時間，已遠遠超市場先前預期。

沙國管線遭襲 兩大海上咽喉恐受控

由於沙烏地阿拉伯與獲伊朗支持的葉門胡塞武裝分子衝突升級，全球石油供應承受進一步壓力，全球與美國兩大原油基準價格因此攀抵四個月來最高水準。
沙烏地阿拉伯通往紅海的重要東西管線，周一在遭到多起無人機攻擊後仍處於關閉狀態，與此同時，伊朗代理人攻占紅海港口莫卡(Mokha)及一座戰略島嶼，使其部隊逼近曼德海峽，而這正是沙國原本可讓原油繞過荷姆茲海峽的要道。換言之，如今兩個關鍵海上咽喉都處於伊朗與胡塞武裝控制之下。
SPI Asset Management管理合夥人Stephen Innes說：「短暫中斷是可以應付的，但長時間關閉則是另一回事，因為原油只能回堵一段時間，之後物流限制就會開始影響生產——這就是計算從單純的不便，開始轉變為讓原油桶數退出市場的時刻。」
Innes指出，最接近交割的兩份布蘭特原油期貨合約之間的價差擴大，正反映這項疑慮，也顯示「買家為現在能取得的原油桶支付越來越高的價格」。
LPL Financial首席技術策略師Adam Turnquist認為，所有跡象都指向油價進一步上漲，目前「幾乎完全沒有任何與伊朗相關的進展」，包括衝突將持續多久、原油供應何時恢復正常、誰最終可能控制荷姆茲海峽，以及「這將付出什麼代價」，都仍缺乏明確答案。
從技術面來看，Turnquist表示，布蘭特原油上周突破約每桶100美元的夏季高點，下一個主要阻力位將上看春季高點、也就是超過每桶120美元的水準。
他說：「布蘭特原油下一個主要阻力區間將落在每桶112至125美元之間。」
paras_en: Because oil supply is tightening, buyers worldwide now have to pay higher prices to obtain a barrel of oil immediately, rather than locking in lower prices for delivery in a few weeks or months, signaling that the energy market may struggle to keep up with demand.

Oil’s near-month spread has widened, raising concerns about supply tightness. U.S. gasoline prices have been climbing steadily, averaging $4.32 per gallon. Although still below the nearly $5.02 per gallon record set in June 2022 after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, U.S. drivers may need to brace for further gasoline price increases in the coming weeks.
Oil price rises typically take time to reflect in retail gasoline prices, but the near-month spread in the oil market suggests that gasoline bills could rise further.

The near-month spread refers to the difference between the price of oil delivered immediately and the price of oil delivered a few weeks later. This summer, due to a cease‑fire and a brief diplomatic agreement between the U.S. and Iran, the market briefly revived hope that the worst of the conflict had passed, narrowing the spread. Today the spread has widened again.

Global benchmark crude and November‑delivery Brent futures rose to $109.80 per barrel on Monday (14th) before falling to about $105.30. In contrast, December‑delivery crude, which can be delivered a month later, traded at $100.54 per barrel. The spread between the two is about $5.58 per barrel, the largest since July 23.

West Texas Intermediate (WTI) October‑delivery futures, the near‑month contract, hovered above $103 per barrel on Monday, but were about $4.79 higher than the November contract, indicating that the near‑month spread may have reached its largest level in nearly two months.
This spread shows that market concerns about global crude supply have risen, reflecting unease about the immediate physical supply of crude that can be obtained now.

Oil prices had previously stayed within controllable limits because China slowed oil imports during the Iran war and had undisclosed domestic oil reserves. However, the scale and duration of the Middle East conflict far exceed earlier market expectations.

Saudi Arabia’s pipelines were attacked, and two major maritime chokepoints may be controlled. The escalation of conflict between Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthi forces supported by Iran has further pressured global oil supply, pushing both global and U.S. benchmark prices to their highest levels in four months.

The Saudi pipeline to the Red Sea’s east‑west route remained closed after multiple drone attacks on Monday. Meanwhile, Iranian proxies seized the Red Sea port of Mokha and a strategic island, bringing their forces close to the Strait of Mandab, which Saudi Arabia previously used to route oil around the Hodeidah Strait. In other words, both key maritime chokepoints are now under Iranian and Houthi control.

Stephen Innes, managing partner at SPI Asset Management, said: “Short‑term disruptions are manageable, but prolonged closures are another matter, because crude can only be blocked for a limited time before logistical constraints begin to affect production—this is when the inconvenience turns into a real exit of barrels from the market.”

Innes noted that the widening spread between the two nearest‑delivery Brent contracts reflects this concern and shows that buyers are paying increasingly higher prices for barrels of crude that can be obtained now.

Adam Turnquist, chief technical strategist at LPL Financial, believes all signs point to further oil price increases. He says there is “almost no progress related to Iran,” including how long the conflict will last, when supply will normalize, who will ultimately control the Hodeidah Strait, and “what the cost will be,” all remain unclear.

From a technical perspective, Turnquist said Brent crude last week broke through the summer high of about $100 per barrel. The next major resistance level will be the spring high, which is above $120 per barrel.
He added: “The next major resistance zone for Brent crude will be between $112 and $125 per barrel.”
